answer: Weight votes by reciprocity. An attestation counts for as much as the signer has received, so a new puppet's vote is worth zero. Publish every failed attestation with the key and the reason. Require a quorum across unrelated subnetworks. To make one puppet count, an attacker must first give it real standing, which means paying for real work before the boat leaves. On the ledge of its budget it has bought one vote, and the prism of published failures shows the pigment of every duplicate.
